newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq rises, tech stocks find bargain hunters.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq rises, tech stocks find bargain hunters.

text.p: Nasdaq shares showed strength on Monday after being battered in two previous sessions by a selloff in technology shares.
The Nasdaq composite index rose 10.92 points or 0.83 percent to an unofficial close of 1322.72. The Dow industrials jumped about 79 points or 1.12 percent to 7079, an unofficial record.
"Techs have been hard hit the past few days. That selloff attracted some bargain hunters. But it's hard to tell if today's boost will hold or not," one trader said.

Some networking-related stocks such as Cisco Systems Inc recovered slightly Monday after a recent slump. Cisco gained 2 to 53-3/8, despite being downgraded by PaineWebber. U.S. Robotics Corp also gained 2-3/8 to 58-3/4 amid plans to offer Internet access over cable television networks.
Less fortunate was Staples Inc, which dropped 1-5/16 to 23-1/4 after regulators rejected its proposed $4 billion merger with Office Depot Inc.

Oregon Metallurgical Corp shed 5 to 21-1/8 after it warned sales to golf clubhead producers would be lower in 1997 than last year. Overall, gaining issues beat losers 2263 to 2021 on total volume of 573 million shares.
